theorem: The [2025,399,14]_2 code intrinsically reconstructs the router cell decomposition from its dual shells. Equal generator columns recover 405 size-4 cold K2,2 classes and 135 size-3 hot classes. After quotienting the full weight-two span, the unique minimum dependencies are 135 disjoint weight-four relations of profile (4,4,4,3), exactly the physical K6 cells.
proof_of_no_outer_weight4: The six extra dual directions are W6 outer words. At every GQ point a W6 word meets an even number of the three incident quotient lines, hence 0 or 2. Adding the local four-class relation changes k to 4-k, so the minimum local quotient contribution remains 0 or 2 on each of three sheet cells. A W6 word of weight 12 or 16 therefore has minimum quotient weight 15*w = 180 or 240, never 4.
boundary: The weight-four statement is for the quotient by the complete weight-two span; the full raw weight-four dual enumerator also contains sums of repetition checks and is not identified with the 135-cell shell.
